ctx.x: Yes. He lived there for many years. Of course, his wife, Leora, used to keep all of her instruments there. You know she played the trumpet, the saxophone too. She was an excellent copyist. She did most of Fletcher's copying, and her writing, her copying was easy for the musicians to read. It was just beautiful. You've seen some of that work.
Uh-huh, right. This is just totally out of my own ignorance. Is she living?
